lore.common: Is rock hard for a week, then goes brown the moment you look away.
lore.uncommon: Has a stone so big that there's hardly any avocado left.
lore.rare: Turns itself to mush the instant someone wants to slice it.
lore.epic: Squashed itself into guacamole in the shopping bag, and the whole lift at the shopping centre went green.
lore.legendary: Was perfectly ripe for exactly five minutes, so the whole family flew home from holiday to eat it in time.

lore.common: Gets pushed to the side of every plate by small hands.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a tiny tree, which some children find very worrying.
lore.rare: Hides inside the mashed potato and jumps out on the very last forkful.
lore.epic: Started a standoff at school dinner that lasted until the bell rang.
lore.legendary: Grew so big on the allotment that a family of squirrels moved in, thinking it was a real tree.

lore.common: Crunches so loudly that nobody can hear the television.
lore.uncommon: Becomes a snowman's nose every winter.
lore.rare: Is said to help you see in the dark, so children eat them before torch games.
lore.epic: Was pulled up by a rabbit so strong that the whole row came up after it like a string of sausages.
lore.legendary: Grew so long underground that it came out on the other side of the world, and a farmer there keeps watering it.

lore.common: Has a stone that gets spat across the garden.
lore.uncommon: Hangs in pairs and gets worn as earrings.
lore.rare: Comes in pairs, and if you eat one, the other follows you round the kitchen until you eat it too.
lore.epic: Spat a stone so hard at the summer fair that it rang the bell on the strongman game.
lore.legendary: Sat on top of a cake so tall that it had its own weather, and came down wearing a tiny snow cap.

lore.common: Needs a hammer, a screwdriver and a lot of patience to open.
lore.uncommon: Has a hairy shell that looks like a tiny monkey.
lore.rare: Falls from the palm tree with a plonk that makes everyone jump.
lore.epic: Took a whole beach party, two spades and a lifeguard to open, and then it was empty.
lore.legendary: Floated across the whole ocean to a beach that already had far too many coconuts, so it went home again.

lore.common: Gets stuck in your teeth for the rest of the day.
lore.uncommon: Drips butter down your chin when you eat it from the cob.
lore.rare: Hears everything through its ears, so the whole field knows the farmer's secrets by lunchtime.
lore.epic: Grew so tall that the maze cut through its field swallowed a school trip until teatime.
lore.legendary: Popped enough popcorn in one go to fill the cinema, so the film had to be shown on the outside wall.

lore.common: Is so watery that it makes the sandwich soggy.
lore.uncommon: Is sliced and put on tired eyes at every spa.
lore.rare: Disguises itself as a courgette whenever someone wants a salad, and as a cucumber whenever they want soup.
lore.epic: Grew so many in one greenhouse that the door burst open and they rolled down the lane like logs.
lore.legendary: Stayed so cool on the hottest day of the year that the whole town queued to stand in its shade.

lore.common: Gleams so purple in the fruit bowl that people think it's plastic.
lore.uncommon: Soaks up oil like a sponge.
lore.rare: Changes its name depending on who is talking, so the family argue about aubergine or eggplant all through dinner.
lore.epic: Gleamed so purple at the market that a magpie stole it and flew it home with great difficulty.
lore.legendary: Grew so big and shiny that the town used it as a mirror, and everyone looked slightly purple for a week.

lore.common: Rolls off the stalk and under the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Drops one grape every step you walk.
lore.rare: Grows two new grapes every time one is eaten, so the bunch never gets any smaller.
lore.epic: Was trodden in a barrel at the harvest party, and the guests' feet stayed purple until spring.
lore.legendary: Grew a bunch so long that it hung from the hilltop vineyard all the way down into the village square.

lore.common: Makes everyone pull a face when they taste it.
lore.uncommon: Has its skin grated into zest for every cake.
lore.rare: Squirts juice straight into your eye when you squeeze it.
lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard on pancake day that the juice hit the ceiling, and the kitchen pulled a sour face for a week.
lore.legendary: Was so sour that the whole lemonade stand puckered shut, and the street could only whistle until teatime.

lore.common: Rolls off the table if anyone bumps it.
lore.uncommon: Spills its seeds everywhere when cut open.
lore.rare: Grows a smiley face on its rind overnight, so nobody has the heart to cut it.
lore.epic: Rolled off the market stall, across the car park and onto the bus, which took it home.
lore.legendary: Was knocked on so often to check if it was ripe that it learned to knock back. It now answers the front door.

lore.common: Makes everyone who chops it cry.
lore.uncommon: Has so many layers that nobody can count them.
lore.rare: Leaves its smell on your hands for the rest of the day.
lore.epic: Made the whole cinema cry during a comedy, and the film won a prize for best sad film.
lore.legendary: Peeled itself for a whole week, layer by layer, and right at the end there was a tiny, very proud pearl onion.

lore.common: Is peeled in one long spiral that breaks just before the end.
lore.uncommon: Leaves white pith stuck under your fingernails.
lore.rare: Has one more segment than it should, and it is always the one that squirts you in the eye.
lore.epic: Rolled out of the half-time bag onto the pitch and scored the winning goal.
lore.legendary: Was peeled in one spiral so long that it reached across town and was cut as the ribbon to open the new bridge.

lore.common: Rustles its big leaves in the wind like applause.
lore.uncommon: Drops coconuts at the worst possible moment.
lore.rare: Fans its big leaves so hard on a hot day that the beach towels blow into the sea.
lore.epic: Bent right over in a storm and flicked every coconut onto the lifeguard hut roof like a drum solo.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall on a tiny island that ships use it as a lighthouse, and it has started winking at them.

lore.common: Has fuzzy skin that makes your teeth tingle.
lore.uncommon: Drips juice down your chin on the first bite.
lore.rare: Ripens at the very moment its owner leaves for a week's holiday, every single time.
lore.epic: Was so juicy that one bite flooded the picnic blanket, and the ants arrived in tiny boats.
lore.legendary: Grew so sweet that the bees gave up making honey and simply came to visit it.

lore.common: Is rock hard on Monday and mush by Wednesday.
lore.uncommon: Goes brown inside even though it looks fine outside.
lore.rare: Makes anything near it go pear-shaped, so the birthday cake slid sideways before the candles were lit.
lore.epic: Dropped onto the car roof just as the alarm was set, and the whole street woke up at midnight.
lore.legendary: Fell from the tallest tree and bounced all the way to the farmers' market, where it sold itself.

lore.common: Has a core full of seeds that spill everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Changes colour from green to yellow to red as it ripens.
lore.rare: Hides one hot pepper in every bag of sweet ones, and it always ends up on Grandad's plate.
lore.epic: Was stuffed with so much rice that it burst in the oven and decorated the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Grew so many colours at once that a rainbow came down to check it was not a relative.

lore.common: Has a spiky top that pokes everyone who carries it.
lore.uncommon: Makes your tongue tingle after eating it.
lore.rare: Wears its leaves like a crown, and every other fruit in the bowl now bows whenever it is picked up.
lore.epic: Rolled off the party table and spiked every balloon in the room on its way to the door.
lore.legendary: Was crowned so convincingly that the fruit bowl held a coronation, and the bananas still carry its train.

lore.common: Grows little sprouts from its eyes when left in the cupboard.
lore.uncommon: Comes out of the ground covered in mud.
lore.rare: Grows eyes that really look around, so the cupboard always knows who has been stealing the crisps.
lore.epic: Sprouted so wildly in the cupboard that it pushed the door open and walked out into the garden.
lore.legendary: Mashed itself so smoothly that the town used it to fill every pothole in the road.

lore.common: Gets its stringy insides scooped out all over the kitchen table.
lore.uncommon: Gets carved into a grinning lantern in autumn.
lore.rare: Grins a little wider every night after it is carved, until it is grinning at the neighbours across the road.
lore.epic: Rolled off the doorstep on a windy night and bowled down the street, knocking over every bin like skittles.
lore.legendary: Grew so big that the family hollowed it out and moved in. The postman now delivers to the stalk.

lore.common: Has seeds on the outside, which nobody can stop thinking about.
lore.uncommon: Is the star of every summer picnic.
lore.rare: Squashes into jam the moment you put it in your pocket.
lore.epic: Got squashed under the picnic blanket so thoroughly that the blanket is now pink and smells of summer.
lore.legendary: Made one jar of jam so good that every slice of toast in town jumped out of the toaster to meet it.

lore.common: Squirts its seeds on your shirt when you bite it.
lore.uncommon: Hides behind its leaves until it is perfectly red, then shows off to every passer-by.
lore.rare: Starts an argument about whether it's a fruit or a vegetable.
lore.epic: Was thrown in a giant food fight at the festival, and the whole town turned red.
lore.legendary: Settled the fruit-or-vegetable argument for good by growing a banana. Nobody has dared mention it since.

lore.common: Drops its leaves just after you've swept the path.
lore.uncommon: Is climbed by every child in the street.
lore.rare: Shifts its roots in the night, so the garden path is a little lumpier every morning.
lore.epic: Shook so hard in a storm that every conker in the park fell at once, and the squirrels declared a holiday.
lore.legendary: Grew so old and so wise that the village owls bring it their problems, and it always tells them to wait and see.

lore.common: Has so many seeds that eating it turns into a spitting game.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on the kitchen counter like it's about to roll away, and someone always lunges.
lore.rare: Gets heavier every time someone tries to carry it, so it always ends up being rolled home.
lore.epic: Rolled off the beach table and was used as the ball for a whole game of beach football without cracking.
lore.legendary: Grew so big that the town cut a door in it and used it as the summer paddling pool.

lore.common: Attracts every wasp in the garden to its fallen apples.
lore.uncommon: Drops its apples one at a time all night long, so the lawn goes thud until morning.
lore.rare: Hides its best apple behind a leaf at the very top, and moves it every time the ladder comes out.
lore.epic: Dropped an apple into the paddling pool, and the children's apple-bobbing game lasted until bedtime.
lore.legendary: Kept the doctor away so well that the village surgery closed and the doctor took up gardening.

lore.common: Has velvety skin that feels like a peach's little cousin.
lore.uncommon: Splits open so neatly that the stone pops out.
lore.rare: Dries itself into a chewy little cushion whenever it is left in the sun, then refuses to be a fruit again.
lore.epic: Ripened so fast in a heatwave that the whole tree turned into jam before anyone could pick it.
lore.legendary: Glowed so orange at dusk that the sun went down early, thinking someone else had taken over.

lore.common: Snaps in half where it gets woody.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who eats it notice something funny later.
lore.rare: Grows so straight that the builders next door borrow it as a spirit level.
lore.epic: Was served in a tall bundle at a posh dinner and toppled over every plate like a game of pick-up sticks.
lore.legendary: Grew one spear so tall that the town hung its flag on it, and the flag is now slightly green.

lore.common: Creaks in the wind like a hundred old doors.
lore.uncommon: Is the favourite hotel of every panda.
lore.rare: Hides a whole path inside it and moves the path a little every night, so hikers come out somewhere new.
lore.epic: Grew so tall overnight that it lifted the picnic table into the air with the picnic still on it.
lore.legendary: Grew a stem so tall that the Moon got stuck on it for a night, and the town had to shake it loose.

lore.common: Hangs bunches so heavy that the tree leans.
lore.uncommon: Has leaves so big that they work as umbrellas.
lore.rare: Swats anyone who tries to pick a bunch before it is ready with one of its giant leaves.
lore.epic: Grew a bunch so heavy that the tree bent right over and offered it to the people at the bus stop.
lore.legendary: Grew a leaf so huge that a whole village sheltered under it in the monsoon, and the rain sounded like applause.

lore.common: Looks like it's been planted upside down with its roots in the air.
lore.uncommon: Stores so much water in its trunk that it swells up.
lore.rare: Flips over at night, so the birds wake up perched on its roots and the roots wake up in the sky.
lore.epic: Held so much water in a drought that the elephants queued at it like a drinking fountain.
lore.legendary: Grew so wide that the town opened a post office inside its trunk, and the queue goes round the outside.

lore.common: Gets pinched at the top every time anyone walks past the windowsill.
lore.uncommon: Gets blended into pesto that turns everything green.
lore.rare: Makes every room it is in smell of pizza, so everyone keeps checking the oven.
lore.epic: Grew so bushy in the window box that the pigeons nested in it and came out smelling of pasta.
lore.legendary: Made a pesto so good that the spaghetti started twirling itself onto the forks.

lore.common: Stains your fingers purple for the whole day.
lore.uncommon: Has to be dug out of the ground with a fork.
lore.rare: Turns everything it touches pink, including things it shouldn't.
lore.epic: Rolled off the table at school dinner and left a pink trail all the way to the head teacher's office.
lore.legendary: Dyed the river pink for a whole summer, and the swans refused to come out until it was white again.

lore.common: Peels its papery bark in strips that blow around the garden.
lore.uncommon: Has white bark with dark stripes like a zebra.
lore.rare: Shakes its catkins and gives everyone hay fever.
lore.epic: Peeled so much papery bark in a gale that the whole school did its homework on it.
lore.legendary: Was so white that the snow mistook it for a friend and stayed on it until July.

lore.common: Snags your jumper with its thorns as you reach for the best berry.
lore.uncommon: Turns everyone's mouth purple after picking.
lore.rare: Grows across the path overnight, so nobody can get past.
lore.epic: Grew over the parked car so fast that its owner had to pick his way to the door and came out with purple hands.
lore.legendary: Grew so fast that it swallowed a whole lane, and the delivery van came out the other side a week later, full of jam.

lore.common: Stains every pancake blue and purple.
lore.uncommon: Rolls off the plate and disappears under the cooker.
lore.rare: Turns anyone's tongue blue, so nobody can ever lie about eating the last muffin.
lore.epic: Burst in the washing machine and dyed the whole family's school shirts blue for a term.
lore.legendary: Gave a whole school blue tongues on picture day, and the photos still hang in the hall.

lore.common: Crunches so loudly that everyone at the table can hear.
lore.uncommon: Is tossed into every stir-fry.
lore.rare: Bounces out of the wok every time it is tossed and lands on the cook's head.
lore.epic: Sizzled so loudly at the street market that the drummers in the parade lost the beat.
lore.legendary: Was tossed so high in the wok that it came down in the next town's soup.

lore.common: Is picked up by every child on every walk.
lore.uncommon: Is carried home by the dog, who chews it on the doorstep.
lore.rare: Moves an inch every night, so the treehouse door never lines up with the ladder.
lore.epic: Fell in a storm and landed exactly across two garden fences, so the neighbours now share a bench.
lore.legendary: Was a dog's fetch stick for so long that the dog learned to throw it back.

lore.common: Is left on the side of every plate at the holiday dinner.
lore.uncommon: Has a reputation that makes everyone laugh.
lore.rare: Rolls itself onto the plate of whoever said they hated it, every single time.
lore.epic: Rolled off every plate at the holiday dinner and under the table, where the dog refused them too.
lore.legendary: Rolled off the holiday table, out of the door and down to the shop, where it put itself back on the shelf.

lore.common: Scratches the side of the car every time it parks in the drive.
lore.uncommon: Gets trimmed into odd shapes by the gardener.
lore.rare: Catches every ball that goes over the fence.
lore.epic: Hid every child at the birthday party at once, and the grown-ups searched for an hour.
lore.legendary: Grew so round that the wind rolled it down the hill like a tumbleweed, and it is now a roundabout.

lore.common: Has a bark-like skin that takes ages to peel.
lore.uncommon: Is dug from the ground in long roots like giant carrots.
lore.rare: Insists on being cooked properly before anyone eats it, and sends back every plate that is not.
lore.epic: Grew roots so long that they came up in the neighbour's garden, and both families claimed it.
lore.legendary: Grew so much underground that the whole field rose up, and the farmer's house now has a sea view.

lore.common: Smells so strongly that the whole garden smells like a pencil.
lore.uncommon: Keeps moths away from the woolly jumpers.
lore.rare: Smells so strongly of pencils that everyone near it starts doing their homework.
lore.epic: Was turned into a chest so moth-proof that the moths of the town held a protest outside it.
lore.legendary: Grew so wide on the mountain that the clouds have to walk round it.

lore.common: Leaves strings stuck between your teeth.
lore.uncommon: Snaps with a crunch that makes the cat jump.
lore.rare: Has so many strings that the music teacher tuned it and played a lullaby on it.
lore.epic: Crunched so loudly at the school concert that the orchestra lost its place and played the song backwards.
lore.legendary: Grew a stalk so tall that the giraffe at the zoo stopped eating leaves and asked for celery.

lore.common: Has stalks in so many colours that it looks painted.
lore.uncommon: Tastes a little bitter, so children make faces.
lore.rare: Sprouts a fresh leaf the moment one is picked, as if it's showing off.
lore.epic: Filled the whole veg patch with colour, and the neighbours thought it was a flower bed.
lore.legendary: Grew stalks in so many colours that the paint shop came to copy them and sold out of every one.

lore.common: Hangs its cherries just out of reach of the shortest person in the house.
lore.uncommon: Is raided by every bird for its cherries before anyone else gets them.
lore.rare: Spits cherry stones at anyone who climbs it without asking first.
lore.epic: Dropped so many cherries on the school roof that the gutters ran pink at home time.
lore.legendary: Grew its cherries so high that a hot-air balloon came to pick them, and the pilot came back with a red mouth.

lore.common: Makes your tongue feel like it's on fire.
lore.uncommon: Hides its heat in the seeds, which everyone forgets.
lore.rare: Hides in the mildest dish on the table, so the curry is safe and the salad is not.
lore.epic: Was so hot that the chef's moustache curled up and the kitchen smoke alarm went off on its own.
lore.legendary: Was so hot that a dragon came all the way down the mountain to ask it for cooking tips.

lore.common: Drops its needles all over the carpet.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in baubles that the cat bats off.
lore.rare: Switches its lights to flashing the moment anyone sits down to watch a film.
lore.epic: Was decorated so heavily that it slowly tipped over and gift-wrapped the cat.
lore.legendary: Wore so many fairy lights that the town's power went out, so it lit the whole street by itself.

lore.common: Leans so far towards the sea that it looks like it's about to fall.
lore.uncommon: Drops coconuts onto anyone resting underneath.
lore.rare: Walks a few steps along the beach when the tide comes in, so the sunbathers keep losing their spot.
lore.epic: Bent so far in a storm that it catapulted its coconuts to the next island, which threw them back.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall that its coconuts take a whole day to land, so it drops tomorrow's ones today.

lore.common: Is so sour that the whole fruit bowl puckers, and the apples have moved to the other side.
lore.uncommon: Bounces when dropped, which is how you know it's good.
lore.rare: Floats to the top of anything: the bath, the soup and the agenda of every meeting.
lore.epic: Rolled out of the sauce jar at the holiday dinner and bounced round the table into Grandad's glass.
lore.legendary: Bounced so high off the kitchen floor that it landed on the Moon, and the Moon has been slightly pink ever since.

lore.common: Is so small that you need a hundred for one mouthful.
lore.uncommon: Dangles in little bunches like tiny beads.
lore.rare: Gets mistaken for a raisin by everyone, and has started correcting them in a very small voice.
lore.epic: Was packed into a bun so tightly that the bun was mostly currants, and it bounced when it was dropped.
lore.legendary: Was so tiny that it rolled into the gap between two seconds, and the town clock has been one second slow ever since.

lore.common: Grows so tall and thin that it looks like a pencil.
lore.uncommon: Points straight up like a green spire.
lore.rare: Grows so tall and thin that it turns up in every holiday photo, exactly behind someone's head.
lore.epic: Blocked the wind so well that the kite festival behind it had to be called off for lack of breeze.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall and pointed that it popped a passing cloud, and the village got a quick shower.

lore.common: Is so sticky that it glues your fingers together.
lore.uncommon: Has a long stone that surprises everyone who bites too fast.
lore.rare: Makes anything it is added to taste like pudding, even the soup.
lore.epic: Glued itself to a camel's knee at the market, and the camel walked funny all the way home.
lore.legendary: Was so sticky that it glued two sand dunes together, and the desert wind still cannot pull them apart.

lore.common: Creaks so loudly in the wind that everyone walks faster.
lore.uncommon: Is home to an owl that hoots every night.
lore.rare: Has no leaves of its own, so every autumn it borrows other trees' leaves and wears them for a day.
lore.epic: Fell over so slowly that the whole town had time to come and watch, and to bring sandwiches.
lore.legendary: Became home to so many owls, beetles and bats that it now has a waiting list.

lore.common: Has leaves so feathery that they float away when chopped.
lore.uncommon: Is the best friend of every pickle jar.
lore.rare: Turns any jar it is put in into a pickle jar, so the jam now tastes of gherkin.
lore.epic: Got into the birthday cake by mistake, and the guests are still deciding whether it was a pickle.
lore.legendary: Made one gherkin so famous that it now has its own fan club and a tiny hat.

lore.common: Has bright pink scales that look like a dragon's skin.
lore.uncommon: Is white and speckled with black seeds inside, like a cookie.
lore.rare: Breathes out a little puff of pink mist when it is sliced, so everyone checks the kettle.
lore.epic: Was sliced open at the picnic, and its black seeds looked so like ants that everyone moved indoors.
lore.legendary: Hatched. Nobody is quite sure what came out, but the garden shed has been very warm ever since.

lore.common: Is worn so smooth by the sea that it feels like silk.
lore.uncommon: Gets found on every beach walk and carried home.
lore.rare: Looks like an animal from one side and a dragon from the other.
lore.epic: Washed up in such a heap that the town built a pier from it, and the pier keeps trying to float home.
lore.legendary: Has washed up on every beach in the world and has a sticker from each one.

lore.common: Smells so strong that the whole shop holds its nose.
lore.uncommon: Has a spiky shell that's dangerous to drop on your foot.
lore.rare: Is banned from buses and hotels because of its smell.
lore.epic: Was opened at the market, and every stall nearby closed for a break.
lore.legendary: Was opened on top of a mountain, and the clouds moved to the next valley.

lore.common: Pops its beans across the table when you squeeze too hard.
lore.uncommon: Is sprinkled with salt and eaten as a snack.
lore.rare: Fires its beans straight into open mouths across the table, but only the mouth of whoever is talking.
lore.epic: Popped so many beans at the sushi bar that the conveyor belt carried them round for an hour.
lore.legendary: Popped every bean in the pod at once like fireworks, and the town cancelled its own display.

lore.common: Attracts wasps to the garden as it ripens.
lore.uncommon: Has crunchy little seeds that get stuck in your teeth.
lore.rare: Hides its flowers inside itself and will not tell anyone where they are.
lore.epic: Dropped so many ripe figs on the patio that the sandals stuck to the ground and had to be left there.
lore.legendary: Ripened on such a hot wall that it dried into a fig roll right there on the branch.

lore.common: Sheds needles into everything nearby.
lore.uncommon: Hangs its cones from the branches like little lanterns.
lore.rare: Holds snow on its branches until someone walks underneath, then lets go.
lore.epic: Grew so thick that the deer use it as a bus shelter in the rain, the whole herd at once.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall that its top is always in winter, even in July. Its bottom branches wear sunglasses.

lore.common: Gives a splinter to everyone who carries it inside.
lore.uncommon: Is always a bit too damp, so it hisses and smokes in the fire.
lore.rare: Refuses to light until everyone gives up, then roars the moment they open the window to let the smoke out.
lore.epic: Stacked itself so neatly in the night that the woodpile is now taller than the cottage.
lore.legendary: Was so heavy that it took the whole family to carry it in, and it now lives in the living room as a bench.

lore.common: Is so knobbly that nobody can peel it properly.
lore.uncommon: Zings your tongue so sharply that your eyes water.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who eats it say 'ooh' at the same moment, so a quiet dinner sounds like fireworks night.
lore.epic: Was grated into the gingerbread so generously that the gingerbread men jumped off the tray and ran out of the door.
lore.legendary: Spiced a single biscuit so strongly that it kept a whole snowy village warm for a week.

lore.common: Looks like a gnarled little hand reaching out of the vegetable box.
lore.uncommon: Shrivels in the back of the fridge until someone finds it months later.
lore.rare: Points its knobbly fingers at whoever left it in the fridge, every time they open the door.
lore.epic: Sprouted in the whole vegetable rack at once, and the kitchen became a tiny jungle.
lore.legendary: Grew such long knobbly fingers that it learned to knit, and made the whole vegetable box scarves.

lore.common: Is so sour and hairy that everyone makes a face.
lore.uncommon: Grows on a bush so thorny that picking is a battle.
lore.rare: Is the odd one out at every picnic, and sits right between the couple on the blanket.
lore.epic: Was so sour that one bite made the whole village choir pull faces in the middle of a song.
lore.legendary: Was the only sweet gooseberry ever grown, and the gardener kept the bush secret.

lore.common: Hangs in such a tangle that the one you want is always behind two others.
lore.uncommon: Snaps in half with a satisfying crack.
lore.rare: Climbs up its pole so fast that it overtakes the gardener.
lore.epic: Grew so many beans that the allotment shed filled up and the gardener had to climb out of the window.
lore.legendary: Climbed so high that it reached the castle in the clouds, and came back down with a goose.

lore.common: Looks green outside but is bright pink inside, which surprises everyone.
lore.uncommon: Is full of hard little seeds.
lore.rare: Smells so sweet that it lures every fruit fly in town into the kitchen, then pretends it was not calling.
lore.epic: Was cut open at breakfast, and it was so pink inside that the whole table gasped and the cat fell off its chair.
lore.legendary: Ripened with such a sweet smell that passing ships turned round, thinking the island was having a party.

lore.common: Hides nettles at the bottom that sting every leg that brushes past.
lore.uncommon: Keeps every ball that goes into it.
lore.rare: Grows a little taller every time the neighbours wave, until nobody can see each other.
lore.epic: Was trimmed so badly in one afternoon that the whole street could see in.
lore.legendary: Was trimmed into a castle so well that a family of foxes moved in and put up a tiny flag.

lore.common: Gets crowded on the windowsill until the pots fall over.
lore.uncommon: Smells of a different herb every time you brush past.
lore.rare: Swaps the labels on its pots in the night, so the mint is the parsley and the soup tastes of toothpaste.
lore.epic: Grew so bushy on the windowsill that the kitchen window disappeared, and the house smells like a garden centre.
lore.legendary: Flavoured the air so strongly that every dinner in the street tasted wonderful, even the burnt ones.

lore.common: Makes your nose tingle the moment it's grated.
lore.uncommon: Has a root so deep that it's impossible to dig up.
lore.rare: Is made into a sauce so strong that it clears every blocked nose.
lore.epic: Was grated so strong that the whole table sneezed at once, and the gravy boat sailed off the end.
lore.legendary: Cleared one blocked nose so hard that the sneeze blew the fog off the whole town.

lore.common: Looks mild, then makes your face sweat.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone reach for milk.
lore.rare: Changes how hot it is depending on who is watching: mild for the cook and fiery for the guest.
lore.epic: Was sliced onto the sleepover pizza, and every child's ears glowed so red that nobody needed a torch.
lore.legendary: Fooled a whole table into thinking it was a green pepper, and nobody has trusted a green pepper since.

lore.common: Has curly leaves that hold onto every drop of water.
lore.uncommon: Is blended into green smoothies that look like swamp water.
lore.rare: Crunches up in the oven and then refuses ever to be called a vegetable again.
lore.epic: Was blended into a smoothie so thick that the blender gave up and went for a lie down.
lore.legendary: Grew so curly in the cold that the hairdresser next door copied it, and now half the town has kale hair.

lore.common: Has fuzzy brown skin like a tiny furry animal.
lore.uncommon: Is cut in half and eaten with a spoon.
lore.rare: Stares at whoever is about to eat it with its seedy green eye, until they put the spoon down.
lore.epic: Rolled out of the fruit bowl so fuzzy that the dog brought it back like a tennis ball.
lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a kiwi bird by a whole flock of kiwi birds, and is now their leader.

lore.common: Is so tiny that it looks like a baby orange.
lore.uncommon: Is eaten whole, skin and all.
lore.rare: Has a sweet skin and a sour middle, which surprises everyone.
lore.epic: Rolled off the party table into the punch bowl and bobbed there all night, turning the punch sour.
lore.legendary: Was so sour in the middle that whoever ate it whistled for a week, and the dogs never left them alone.

lore.common: Hides grit between its layers that crunches in the soup.
lore.uncommon: Is the most important part of every winter soup.
lore.rare: Grows a little bigger every time the gardener next door walks past, just to annoy him.
lore.epic: Grew so big that the gardener rode it home from the allotment like a horse.
lore.legendary: Grew so big that it was carried through the village on a stretcher.

lore.common: Has thorns on its branches that catch your sleeves.
lore.uncommon: Has blossom that smells so sweet you forget the lemons are sour.
lore.rare: Drops a lemon into every glass of water left near it, so nobody ever gets a plain drink.
lore.epic: Dropped so many lemons in the heatwave that the garden pond turned into lemonade and the frogs got hiccups.
lore.legendary: Gave life so many lemons that life gave up and made lemonade.

lore.common: Is home to so many beetles that it crawls when you look closely.
lore.uncommon: Rolls a log off the top every time the wind blows.
lore.rare: Hides a toad underneath that jumps out when you lift a log.
lore.epic: Was taken apart for the fire, and so many creatures came out that the family put it all back.
lore.legendary: Housed so many hedgehogs that they formed a marching band and parade round the garden at midnight.

lore.common: Has a bumpy pink shell that's tricky to peel.
lore.uncommon: Is white and shiny inside like a pearl.
lore.rare: Has a slippery stone in the middle that shoots out when squeezed.
lore.epic: Shot its stone across the restaurant into the waiter's top pocket, and he took it home as a souvenir.
lore.legendary: Was threaded onto a pearl necklace by mistake and went to a grand ball before anyone noticed.

lore.common: Drips juice down your arm all the way to your elbow.
lore.uncommon: Never shows when it is ripe, so everyone stands in the shop squeezing it like an accordion.
lore.rare: Turns into a hedgehog when it is cut, then curls up on the plate and refuses to be eaten.
lore.epic: Dripped so much juice on the hot pavement that it became a sticky trap for every flip-flop in the street.
lore.legendary: Was cut into a hedgehog the size of a sofa, and the real hedgehogs came from miles around to pay their respects.

lore.common: Drips sticky sap onto every car parked underneath it in spring.
lore.uncommon: Has sap that's boiled into sweet syrup.
lore.rare: Turns its sap into syrup inside the trunk, so every woodpecker in the wood gets sweet hiccups.
lore.epic: Was tapped so eagerly that the syrup came out like a fountain, and the pancake breakfast floated away.
lore.legendary: Made so much syrup in one spring that the river ran sweet, and the fish now stick together.

lore.common: Spreads so fast that it takes over every flowerbed.
lore.uncommon: Makes your breath smell fresh for an hour.
lore.rare: Freshens the breath of anyone who walks past, so nobody in the house can tell who ate the garlic.
lore.epic: Was dropped into the lemonade at the fair, and the whole tent got so fresh that everyone's teeth squeaked.
lore.legendary: Freshened the air so well that the town rubbish tip smelled of toothpaste all summer.

lore.common: Looks like a peach that forgot to grow fuzz.
lore.uncommon: Shines so smoothly in the fruit bowl that the peaches have started feeling hairy.
lore.rare: Bruises if you so much as look at it.
lore.epic: Rolled into the paddling pool and floated there so smugly that the rubber ducks moved out.
lore.legendary: Was so smooth that the fruit bowl used it as a mirror, and the bananas now check their spots in it.

lore.common: Drops acorns on the shed roof all autumn.
lore.uncommon: Is home to every squirrel in the park.
lore.rare: Drops acorns only on the squirrels who forgot where they buried the last ones.
lore.epic: Dropped so many acorns in one autumn that the squirrels couldn't bury them all.
lore.legendary: Grew one acorn so big that the squirrels had to roll it home together, and they are still eating it.

lore.common: Goes slimy when it's cut.
lore.uncommon: Is fuzzy like a little green finger.
lore.rare: Goes slimy at the exact moment someone says it is not slimy.
lore.epic: Thickened the festival gumbo so much that it had to be served in slices.
lore.legendary: Grew so many slippery pods that the slugs of the county came to it for lessons.

lore.common: Has a pit inside that surprises every tooth.
lore.uncommon: Is so salty that it makes you thirsty.
lore.rare: Tastes like a grape to everyone who is expecting a grape, and that is the trouble.
lore.epic: Rolled down the restaurant steps, and the waiter chased it all the way to the harbour.
lore.legendary: Was pressed into oil so smooth that the town's squeaky gate has not squeaked since.

lore.common: Has a trunk so twisted that it looks like it's dancing.
lore.uncommon: Has silver leaves that shimmer in the wind.
lore.rare: Flashes its silver leaves in the sun to dazzle the pickers, so half the olives are never found.
lore.epic: Twisted its trunk so hard in a storm that it turned to face the sea, and refuses to turn back.
lore.legendary: Is so old that it remembers when the hill was flat, and keeps reminding the hill.

lore.common: Smells so sweet in blossom that the bees go dizzy.
lore.uncommon: Hangs oranges so heavy that the branches touch the ground.
lore.rare: Rolls an orange down the drive towards whoever is having a bad day.
lore.epic: Dropped so many oranges on the hill that the street below became an orange river, and the postman floated home.
lore.legendary: Gave so much juice that the town fountain was switched to orange, and the pigeons have never been healthier.

lore.common: Has a belly full of black seeds that look like caviar.
lore.uncommon: Is bright orange inside like a sunset.
lore.rare: Softens any meat it touches, so the barbecue sausages fell apart before they reached the plate.
lore.epic: Fell from its tree onto the beach volleyball game, and the match became a fruit salad.
lore.legendary: Ripened so perfectly that the sunrise waited for it, and the morning started ten minutes late.

lore.common: Is put on every plate as a garnish and never eaten.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck in your teeth so everyone can see it.
lore.rare: Hides a caterpillar in its curly leaves that only appears when it reaches the plate.
lore.epic: Was sprinkled on the wedding cake by a confused chef, and the guests are still picking green bits out of their teeth.
lore.legendary: Was the only garnish ever eaten by every diner at the restaurant.

lore.common: Looks like a carrot that forgot its colour.
lore.uncommon: Gets sweeter after the frost.
lore.rare: Pretends to be a carrot in the dark, so the snowman ends up with a pale nose.
lore.epic: Roasted so sweetly that the whole dinner was eaten before anyone remembered the gravy.
lore.legendary: Got so sweet in the frost that the snowmen in the field queued up to swap their carrots for it.

lore.common: Looks wrinkly and old just when it's perfectly ripe.
lore.uncommon: Is full of crunchy seeds floating in sweet jelly.
lore.rare: Turns any pudding tropical, so the school custard now has a suntan.
lore.epic: Was dropped into the yoghurt factory, and every pot in the country came out crunchy for a week.
lore.legendary: Wrinkled into such perfect ripeness that the town's grandads asked for its secret. It said 'more sitting down'.

lore.common: Pops open and sends peas rolling under the table.
lore.uncommon: Has peas that roll off the plate no matter how carefully you eat.
lore.rare: Zips itself shut again whenever someone tries to open it, like a stubborn purse.
lore.epic: Popped open in the school canteen and sent peas bouncing into every child's custard.
lore.legendary: Grew a pea so big that a princess slept on it, forty mattresses up, and still did not get a wink.

lore.common: Dries out your mouth if eaten before it's ripe.
lore.uncommon: Looks like an orange tomato hanging on the tree.
lore.rare: Holds on to its branch all winter and refuses to fall until everyone has stopped looking.
lore.epic: Dropped all at once in the first frost and bounced down the street like orange tennis balls.
lore.legendary: Hung on so long that the tree grew new leaves round it, and even the tree cannot say which year it belongs to.

lore.common: Covers the ground in needles that prickle bare feet.
lore.uncommon: Leaves sticky resin on your hands that won't wash off.
lore.rare: Whispers in the wind so convincingly that hikers turn round to answer it.
lore.epic: Scented the whole forest so strongly that every walker came out smelling like a brand-new car.
lore.legendary: Grew so high up the mountain that it holds the summit flag, and the climbers have to ask its permission.

lore.common: Splits its skin the night before you planned to pick it.
lore.uncommon: Has a stone that surprises every tooth.
lore.rare: Hides its ripe plums behind the hard ones, so every picker gets the hard ones.
lore.epic: Dropped so many plums on the parked car that it drove away looking like a purple leopard.
lore.legendary: Dried so slowly in the sun that it became a prune, then changed its mind and became a plum again.

lore.common: Has a peel so thick that it takes ten minutes to get through.
lore.uncommon: Is the biggest citrus fruit, bigger than a grapefruit.
lore.rare: Has a peel that children wear as a hat.
lore.epic: Rolled off the market stall, was mistaken for a bowling ball and knocked down every skittle in the alley.
lore.legendary: Has a peel so thick that a family of mice lives in it and has never met the fruit inside.

lore.common: Is so wrinkly that it looks a hundred years old.
lore.uncommon: Is every grandma's favourite breakfast fruit.
lore.rare: Wrinkles everything it is kept next to, so the raisins look younger beside it.
lore.epic: Soaked overnight in the breakfast bowl and swelled up so much that it lifted the lid off the cereal box.
lore.legendary: Was so wrinkly that a map maker traced its creases and drew a whole new mountain range.

lore.common: Is so hard that you need a hammer to cut it raw.
lore.uncommon: Has fuzzy yellow skin that smells like perfume.
lore.rare: Perfumes the whole cupboard so strongly that the biscuits now taste of quince.
lore.epic: Was so hard to cut that the cook borrowed the woodcutter's axe, and the kitchen table split in two.
lore.legendary: Cooked down into a jelly so firm that the town used it to fix the wobbly bridge.

lore.common: Bites back with a peppery kick.
lore.uncommon: Pops up pink and round like a tiny balloon.
lore.rare: Grows so fast that it's ready before you've watered it twice.
lore.epic: Grew so fast in the school garden that the class had to harvest it in the middle of maths.
lore.legendary: Was so peppery that one slice cleared the whole class's colds, and the school nurse went on holiday.

lore.common: Is so wrinkly that it looks like a grape that's had a long bath.
lore.uncommon: Hides in the bottom of every lunchbox.
lore.rare: Pretends to be a chocolate chip in every cookie, and disappoints everyone.
lore.epic: Fell out of a lunchbox into the school radiator and slowly turned back into a grape.
lore.legendary: Told the young grapes such stories about lying in the sun that they all asked to be dried.

lore.common: Makes everyone crane their necks to see the top.
lore.uncommon: Has bark so soft that you can punch it without hurting your hand.
lore.rare: Drinks so much fog that the town below it never has a misty morning, and the photographers are furious.
lore.epic: Dropped a cone from the very top, and it took so long to land that the walkers had a picnic while they waited.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall that it has its own weather at the top, and the squirrels up there wear woolly hats.

lore.common: Has leaves like little needles that prickle your fingers.
lore.uncommon: Is the best friend of every roast dinner.
lore.rare: Is said to help the memory, so it remembers every single time someone forgot to water it.
lore.epic: Grew so bushy over the path that the postman came out of it smelling like Sunday lunch.
lore.legendary: Remembered so much that it reminded the whole town of every birthday, and nobody has missed one since.

lore.common: Spills lettuce over the edge every time it's tossed.
lore.uncommon: Gets drowned in dressing until the lettuce goes soggy.
lore.rare: Hides all the croutons at the bottom, so whoever serves last gets every one.
lore.epic: Was tossed so eagerly at the barbecue that the lettuce landed on the neighbour's hedge.
lore.legendary: Was the only salad ever finished at a family barbecue.

lore.common: Hides the garden tap so nobody can find it.
lore.uncommon: Has prickly leaves that scratch your ankles.
lore.rare: Grows back in the shape of whoever last trimmed it, so the garden now has a bush that looks like Grandad.
lore.epic: Grew so fast round the bird bath that the birds now have to book a table.
lore.legendary: Grew so wide and so round that the garden is now a shrub with a small house in the middle.

lore.common: Wilts to a tiny pile the moment it's cooked.
lore.uncommon: Is said to make you strong, so children flex after eating it.
lore.rare: Gives a little burst of strength to whoever eats it, so every jam jar in the house is now open.
lore.epic: Was eaten by the school tug-of-war team, and they pulled the other team, the rope and the goalposts across the field.
lore.legendary: Gave a tortoise so much energy that it won the town fun run, and it still has not stopped.

lore.common: Leaves a strong smell on your breath.
lore.uncommon: Has a long green stalk and a little white bulb.
lore.rare: Makes everyone's breath so strong that the dentist works with the window open.
lore.epic: Was chopped so finely at the noodle bar that a breeze blew it into every bowl in the street.
lore.legendary: Grew so many stalks at once that the noodle bar used it as a broom, and the floor now smells delicious.

lore.common: Crunches in every sandwich.
lore.uncommon: Grows in a jar on the windowsill.
lore.rare: Wriggles its little tails in the jar, so everyone checks that it is not full of worms.
lore.epic: Burst out of the jar in one night and filled the kitchen windowsill.
lore.legendary: Sprouted so fast in a forgotten lunchbox that it grew a tiny garden, complete with a tiny fence.

lore.common: Drips sticky sap onto every tent pitched beneath it.
lore.uncommon: Smells so strongly of the winter holidays that people start wrapping presents in June.
lore.rare: Hums when it is tapped, so the woodpeckers keep stopping to listen and never finish a hole.
lore.epic: Dropped a whole winter of snow off its branches at once, and buried the ski hut door.
lore.legendary: Was made into a violin that played so well that the forest it came from swayed in time.

lore.common: Turns into perfect stars when sliced.
lore.uncommon: Has waxy skin that shines in the light.
lore.rare: Catches the light so well that its slices twinkle on the plate, and the moths circle the dinner table.
lore.epic: Was sliced into stars for the school play, and the cast had to eat the sky before the second act.
lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a real star by a lost ship, which followed it all the way to the fruit market.

lore.common: Is purple inside, which surprises everyone who cuts it.
lore.uncommon: Has a hairy brown skin like a coconut.
lore.rare: Grows leaves so big and waterproof that the frogs use them as umbrellas and will not give them back.
lore.epic: Turned a whole cafe's bubble tea purple, and the customers' tongues matched the cafe sign for a week.
lore.legendary: Was so knobbly and hairy that the school mistook it for the class hamster and sent it home for the holidays.

lore.common: Has leaves so tiny that it takes ages to pick them off the stalk.
lore.uncommon: Gets stripped off its stalk by running your fingers down it.
lore.rare: Makes time pass slower in the kitchen, so the soup takes ages and the cook is always late.
lore.epic: Was stirred into the stew so late that the stew had already been eaten yesterday.
lore.legendary: Had so much thyme on its hands that it stopped the town clock and let everyone have a lie-in.

lore.common: Wobbles like jelly when you pick it up.
lore.uncommon: Soaks up every flavour like a sponge.
lore.rare: Tastes of whatever is next to it, so the fruit salad ended up tasting of garlic.
lore.epic: Wobbled so much on the plate that the table, the chairs and the guests started wobbling too.
lore.legendary: Wobbled so hard that it set off the town's earthquake alarm, and the jelly factory got the blame.

lore.common: Loses its shape in one week of rain.
lore.uncommon: Needs a tiny pair of scissors and a very steady gardener to stay in shape.
lore.rare: Changes its animal shape overnight, so the peacock is a rabbit by morning.
lore.epic: Was trimmed into a lion so convincing that the postman would not come through the gate.
lore.legendary: Was trimmed into an elephant so lifelike that it walked off to the zoo and asked to be let in.

lore.common: Is sat on by everyone on the walk, even when it's damp.
lore.uncommon: Has rings that everyone counts to see how old it is.
lore.rare: Pretends to be a stool, then grows a mushroom exactly where you were going to sit.
lore.epic: Was used as a table for the whole picnic, and the sandwiches tasted of moss.
lore.legendary: Grew back into a whole tree overnight after being chopped down, and the woodcutter said sorry.

lore.common: Was carved into a lantern before pumpkins were popular.
lore.uncommon: Has a purple top and a white bottom.
lore.rare: Rolls under the kitchen table whenever anyone mentions soup.
lore.epic: Rolled off the farm cart and down the village hill, with the farmer running after it.
lore.legendary: Grew so big that the family, the dog, the cat and a mouse all had to pull it up, and the mouse took the credit.

lore.common: Snaps loudly under your foot at exactly the moment you are trying to sneak up on someone.
lore.uncommon: Gets waved like a magic wand by every child.
lore.rare: Turns into a wand in any child's hand, but only does tiny spells, like untying shoelaces.
lore.epic: Fell into the stream, raced the paper boats all the way to the sea, and won.
lore.legendary: Was waved so hard by one child that the rain stopped, and the school sports day went ahead after all.

lore.common: Drapes its branches so low that you have to duck under them.
lore.uncommon: Dips its leaves into the river like it's having a drink.
lore.rare: Weeps onto anyone who sits underneath it, then says it was only the dew.
lore.epic: Dipped its branches into the river and fished out every lost football in the town.
lore.legendary: Wept so much in one summer that the river rose, and the whole town went to work by boat.

lore.common: Is so knobbly that it's hard to peel.
lore.uncommon: Roasts so sweetly that it tastes like a pudding.
lore.rare: Pretends to be a sweet potato at the shop, and nobody can prove otherwise.
lore.epic: Was so heavy that the harvest cart tipped over and the yam rolled to the front of the parade.
lore.legendary: Was roasted so sweetly that the pudding trolley sent it a note saying it had gone too far.

lore.common: Has a bumpy skin full of fragrant oil.
lore.uncommon: Smells so wonderful that people sniff it like a flower.
lore.rare: Is so sour that a single drop flavours a whole bowl.
lore.epic: Floated in the bath so happily that it refused to get out, and the family had to shower for a week.
lore.legendary: Scented the steam from one bath so strongly that the whole street had a warm, lemony fog for a day.
